title: Apply for an E-Toll Account concession
summary: Find out if you are eligible for and how to apply for concessions on an E-Toll Account if you are a concession card holder.
intro:
If you're a concession card holder, you may be eligible for certain concessions on a new or existing E-Toll Account, including:

You need to apply in person at a Service NSW Centre.
who_can_apply: Pensioner Concession Card or confirmation of concession card entitlement form (showing a NSW address)
DVA Veteran Gold Card printed with one of the following
Letter from the DVA confirming one of the following
Must be the E-Toll Account holder and have one of the following
what_you_need: Your eligible concession card or letter
A copy of your registration papers showing the '87 condition' recorded against your vehicle (if you drive a modified vehicle with hand controls)
Your account number if you already have an E-Toll Account

how_to_steps.text: Gather the required documents and visit a service centre to lodge your application.

faqs.q: Where do I need to apply for an E-Toll Account concession?
faqs.a: You must apply in person at a Service NSW Centre.

faqs.q: What documents do I need to apply for an E-Toll Account concession?
faqs.a: You need your eligible concession card or letter, a copy of your registration papers showing the '87 condition' (if applicable), your account number, and the E-Toll application form.

faqs.q: Who is eligible to apply for an E-Toll Account concession?
faqs.a: Eligibility depends on whether you have a Pensioner Concession Card, DVA Veteran Gold Card, or if you are the E-Toll Account holder with specific documentation.
